name: Small Breach (Piping Failure / Partial Sluice Gate Collapse)
description: Gradual internal piping erosion through dam body or partial spillway gate failure. Controlled hydrograph with slower rising limb (~90 mins formation).

name: Medium Breach (Overtopping / Partial Crest Breach)
description: Standard PMF (Probable Maximum Flood) overtopping scenario leading to progressive breach development within 48 minutes.

name: Large Catastrophic Breach (Full Monolith Collapse / Seismic Failure)
description: Sudden near-instantaneous structural collapse under extreme seismic or extreme headwater conditions, generating high-amplitude hydrodynamic shockwaves.
